name: sister_orders
description: The Magus Sisters' order handlers (script events 13 to 20 of the three sister workers) on the game's own script VM: each run gives one sister's state and the answers of the natives (the usable flag and candidates of each searched command, the draws of streams 18 and 4), and records the ordered log of every effectful call (rolls, searches, standing-order writes, gain calls, performs, the Delta Attack) and the sister's private variables afterwards.

harness.note: search: the real machine code of the functions in an x86-32 emulator with the battle generator scripted; handlers: the sister workers of the battle-system script on the game VM, natives answered by a Python world (the chance roll, the search as an oracle, the gain calls, the standing-order store, the command buffer, performCommand); the game is never run

notes: A stratified subset (every 75th run of each event) of the 24,000 runs of research/re-ffx-zanmato-and-orders.md section 15.2 (seed 20261019, the same draw order); each exported run was also checked equal to the RE session's independent model.

Log entries: ["roll", a, b, result, draw & 0xFF or null], ["search", cmd, T, P, F, C, slot (255 none), draw or null or "unusable"], ["stand", value], ["gain2", gauge, motivation], ["gain4", [gaugePos, motivationPos, gaugeNeg, motivationNeg]], ["perform", target, cmd] (target -16 = the stored group, -13 = herself), ["delta"].

`in.st`: M the motivation; hp, mhp, mp, mmp her own; stand the standing order; cindy_alive and cindy_reflect (Mindy); last, flag, cls the private variables; lst and cnt Mindy's stored list; d18 and d4 the draws consumed.
